```yaml
name: CDK Source Connector Compatibility Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'airbyte-cdk/**'
      - 'airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-*/**'
      - 'airbyte-integrations/builder/source-toolkit/**'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'airbyte-cdk/**'
      - 'airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-*/**'
      - 'airbyte-integrations/builder/source-toolkit/**'

jobs:
  source-connector-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Get certified source connectors
        run: tools/bin/bulk-cdk/get-certified-connectors.sh sources

      - name: Run source connector compatibility tests
        run: |
          # The script above populates a list of connectors to test.
          # The following command runs the CDK compatibility test for each connector.
          # Adjust the command below to match the actual test harness in the repository.
          ./gradlew cdk:sourceConnectorCompatibilityTest
```
